orientation_contract: panel local +X maps to receiver outward normal; local +Y maps receiver lateral; local +Z maps receiver up
standoff_semantics: Under the exact service-pavilion receiver-fit convention, this is the receiver-normal distance from interface origin to panel body center. Physical body gap beyond the receiver plate is standoff - plate_thickness - 0.5 * body_depth.

provenance.relationship: separate receiving part for service-pavilion-001 receiver-frame test
provenance.clearance_successor_change: correct standoff 0.08 -> 0.10 m so the full 0.08 m body, not only its center, preserves the declared 0.02 m body gap beyond the 0.04 m receiver plate

truth_boundary: This panel is sparse evidence geometry for repeated receiver-frame fit. The corrected standoff proves only the exact source-local receiver-normal body gap under the declared service-pavilion receiver-fit convention. It does not establish hinges, latches, fasteners, seals, engineering loads, materials, UVs, runtime attachment, collision or final visual quality.
